title: Two griefs
notes: The last call, once both halves of the story are in: the world made by
grief, being unmade by grief. Both makers the last of something.

lines.text: Shepard. Nothing's wrong. I just want to say a thing
out loud to somebody who'll understand it.
Shepard. No emergency. When you've got a second.
A Douwd made this county because he couldn't bear
one death. A Changeling is emptying it because it
couldn't bear a genocide. Made by grief, and unmade.
Both of them the last of something. Both alone.
No. It explains it. That's all I'm good for.
We're the ones who aren't alone. That's the difference.
A hundred and forty up here. You down there.
The ones you've brought up. We have each other.
It's not a plan. It's just true. Shepard out.
